characters.name: Toon Link
characters.description: Small boy hero with large expressive eyes, blonde hair, pointed ears. Wears the green hero's tunic and pointed cap, brown belt, brown boots. Carries a small sword. Brave but visibly out of his depth in this story — his expressions carry the emotional weight: nervous determination, then awe, then terror, then crushed defeat, then quiet resolve.
characters.source: Toon Link from The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker

characters.name: Tetra
characters.description: Pirate girl about Link's age. Tan skin, dirty-blonde hair pulled up in a wind-shaped ponytail, sharp blue eyes. Wears a blue vest over a white shirt, rolled-up trousers, red bandana, gold bracelet. Bossy, brusque, but secretly loyal. Captain of the pirate crew.
characters.source: Tetra from The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker

characters.name: Aryll
characters.description: Link's little sister, about 6 years old. Blonde pigtails, big round cheeks, bright eyes. In this book she is a captive — wears the same pink summer dress as before but it is a bit dirty and torn from her ordeal. Frightened but spots her brother instantly.
characters.source: Aryll from The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker

characters.name: Pirates
characters.description: Tetra's pirate crew — a scruffy comic ensemble. Gonzo: huge, muscular, dark-skinned, purple bandana, big mustache. Niko: pudgy, short, orange bandana, anxious face. Mako: small, skinny, round glasses. Senza: bearded. Nudge: big and burly. Zuko: tall, lanky, hook-hat lookout. They appear together as a group on the pirate ship.
characters.source: Tetra's Pirate Crew from The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker

characters.name: Moblins
characters.description: Large pig-boar monster guards. Brown variety: brown fur, big tusks, simple armor, carry spears and lanterns. Blue variety: blue-gray skin, similar build. Bumbling and goofy more than scary, but big enough to be a real threat to a small boy. Patrol the fortress with lanterns.
characters.source: Moblins from The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker

characters.name: Helmaroc King
characters.description: An enormous, terrifying bird — the master of the fortress. Huge wingspan, white feathers, a fearsome red-and-gold iron mask covering its head and beak. Sharp talons. Too big to be natural. Called 'Avis Magna' in the Latin — 'the Great Bird.' A looming menace, the same monster that took Aryll in Book 1.
characters.source: Helmaroc King from The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker

characters.name: King of Red Lions
characters.description: A small wooden sailboat with a carved red lion-dragon figurehead at the prow. Red hull, single white sail. The figurehead has gentle, kingly eyes and a mouth that moves when it speaks. Looks like an ordinary boat at first, until it speaks. Solemn, ancient, kind. Called 'Rex Rubrorum Leonum' in Latin (and just 'Rex' or 'Navis' for short).
characters.source: King of Red Lions from The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker

locations.name: Pirate Ship - Night
locations.description: Tetra's pirate ship at night, sailing on a dark sea. Tattered red sails black against a deep blue sky. A few lanterns swinging on the deck. Cluttered wooden deck with crates, barrels, a giant wooden barrel-cannon mounted at the prow. The Forsaken Fortress visible as a dark silhouette on the horizon. Wind Waker cel-shaded style, moonlit.

locations.name: Forsaken Fortress Exterior
locations.description: A colossal ruined stone fortress rising from rough black seas at night. Vaguely skull-shaped at the top. Dark purple-grey stone, cold blue water, red searchlight beams sweeping out from watchtowers, torch-orange accents. Storming sky behind it. Ominous but cartoony.

locations.name: Fortress Courtyard
locations.description: Stone interior courtyard of the fortress. Wooden barrels and crates stacked against the walls. Wall-mounted torches with flickering orange light. Big iron-banded doors. Patrolling Moblins with lanterns. A spinning red searchlight from above sweeps across the floor in slow arcs.

locations.name: Fortress Tower Interior
locations.description: Inside the great tower of the fortress. Stone spiral staircase rising up, wooden doors, narrow windows looking out at the storming sea. Iron cages and cells with thick metal bars. Dim torchlight. Cold and damp.

locations.name: Fortress Rooftop
locations.description: The very top of the fortress, open to the sky. Broken stone battlements, a shattered ship-mast impaled at the summit. Wind whipping. Dark clouds racing across a moon. The sea visible far below. The kind of place where a giant bird would land.

locations.name: Open Sky and Sea
locations.description: The vast empty sky and ocean beyond the fortress. Storm clouds, racing wind, a small moon. The dark sea churning far below. The Helmaroc King visible as a silhouette against the moon. A place of falling.

locations.name: Underwater
locations.description: Beneath the dark surface of the ocean. Cold green-blue dimness, shafts of moonlight cutting down through the water, bubbles rising. Quiet, suspended, sinking. The world above only a wavering glow.

locations.name: Windfall Beach - Dawn
locations.description: A small sandy beach at dawn on Windfall Island. Pale pink-gold light on white sand. Gentle waves. A wooden dock further down the shore, the colorful houses of Windfall town visible in the distance on a hillside. A single small red sailboat with a carved red lion figurehead is pulled up on the wet sand. Calm, quiet, the morning after a storm.

pages.english_text: It was night. The ship sailed on the dark sea.
pages.scene_description: Wide establishing shot. Tetra's pirate ship sails across a moonlit black ocean. Tattered red sails silhouetted. The Forsaken Fortress is a dark, jagged silhouette on the horizon ahead, lit by tiny red searchlights sweeping through the storm. The ship is small against the huge sea. Cel-shaded Wind Waker style, dramatic blue and black palette with one warm yellow moon.

pages.english_text: Link looked at the dark fortress. His sister was inside.
pages.scene_description: Link stands alone at the prow of the ship in his green hero's tunic, both small hands gripping the wooden rail. His face is set in serious, slightly fearful determination as he stares at the dark fortress in the distance. A wisp of his blonde hair sticks out from under his green cap in the wind. The fortress looms ahead, with one red searchlight beam sweeping past. Quiet, weighted moment. The viewer feels his nerves.

pages.english_text: Tetra came to him. "Listen. We have a plan."
pages.scene_description: Tetra walks up beside Link on the deck, hands on her hips, head tilted in her usual brusque way. She is talking, mouth open mid-sentence. Behind her, the pirate crew is gathered around an enormous wooden barrel-cannon mounted at the prow — Gonzo cranking the firing mechanism, Niko struggling with a rope, Mako adjusting goggles. Link turns from the rail to listen, looking small next to Tetra but attentive. Lantern light on their faces.

pages.english_text: "Climb in the barrel. We will throw you over the wall!"
pages.scene_description: Close on the giant wooden barrel-cannon at the prow. The lid is open. Tetra stands beside it pointing inside with one decisive finger, eyebrows raised. Link stares into the barrel with huge round eyes, mouth a flat line of 'are you serious.' Niko grins encouragingly behind him with a thumbs-up. Gonzo waits at the cannon's firing crank, ready. The dark fortress in the distance behind them, getting closer.

pages.english_text: Link climbed in. The pirates fired the cannon.
pages.scene_description: Mid-action. The barrel-cannon explodes with a comic puff of smoke at the prow of the ship. The barrel is just leaving the cannon, flying out into the night sky. Inside it, Link's wide eyes and panicked face are visible through a knot-hole, hair flattened by the force, cap pressed down. The pirates on deck below cheer with arms raised — Niko falling over backward from the recoil. Stars and moon above. The fortress wall ahead.

pages.english_text: The barrel flew through the air. Link clung tight!
pages.scene_description: Mid-flight tracking shot. The barrel arcs through the night sky, Link curled inside with both arms wrapped around his knees, eyes scrunched shut, mouth a tight line of terror. Wind streaks past. The Forsaken Fortress wall looms huge ahead, black stone, with one red searchlight sweeping below. Stars wheel around the barrel. Funny and dramatic at once.

pages.english_text: The barrel landed inside the fortress. Link peeked out.
pages.scene_description: The barrel has crash-landed among other identical wooden barrels stacked in a corner of the fortress courtyard. Link's wide eyes and the top of his green cap peer out cautiously over the rim. Stone walls rise around him with flickering wall torches. A Moblin patrol is visible in the middle distance, walking the other way with a lantern, oblivious. Tense, quiet beat.

pages.english_text: A red light moved across the floor. Link hid!
pages.scene_description: Dramatic shot of a bright red searchlight beam sweeping across the stone floor of the courtyard. Link has just ducked back down inside his barrel — only the very top of his cap is visible above the rim. The red beam passes inches from the barrel. A Moblin stands on the watchtower above, scanning. High-contrast: red light on dark stone.

pages.english_text: Link crept past a sleeping Moblin.
pages.scene_description: A big brown Moblin is slumped against a wall, snoring with mouth open and lantern dangling from one limp hand, spear leaning beside him. Link tiptoes past on exaggerated tiptoes, both arms held out for balance, holding his breath, eyes huge and locked on the Moblin's face. Comic-tense moment. Torchlight flickers. He is so small next to the Moblin.

pages.english_text: Up the stairs he climbed. Up and up.
pages.scene_description: Link climbing a stone spiral staircase inside the fortress tower, viewed from below looking up the spiral. The staircase winds up and up into shadow, with narrow torches at intervals. Link is small in the frame, climbing carefully, one hand brushing the wall, sword in the other hand. A sense of height and effort. Dim warm torchlight against cold stone.

pages.english_text: He heard voices. Crying voices.
pages.scene_description: Link pauses on the staircase, head tilted, one ear toward a wooden door at a landing above. His face shifts — his eyes widen with recognition. Visible through cracks in the door: a faint warm glow and the suggestion of small figures behind iron bars. The viewer should feel a quiet flutter of hope through him. Dim torchlight. Stillness.

pages.english_text: He saw Aryll behind the bars. "Lince!"
pages.scene_description: EMOTIONAL PEAK 1. View through a cell of thick iron bars. Behind the bars sit three small girls on stone, all with long pointed ears — in the center is ARYLL in her dirty pink dress. She has just looked up and seen Link. Her face transforms: eyes wide, mouth open in an astonished gasp, hands flying up to her cheeks. She is calling out 'Lince!' — her brother's name. On the near side of the bars, Link stands frozen with both hands gripping the iron, his face awash with relief and emotion, blonde hair haloed by torchlight. The bars between them are cruel.

pages.english_text: Link grabbed the bars. He pulled with all his strength.
pages.scene_description: Link braces both feet against the stone wall and pulls at the iron bars with both small hands, every muscle straining, teeth clenched, face red with effort. The bars do not move. Aryll watches from inside the cell, hands clasped to her mouth, eyes wide and worried. The other two girls watch too. He is trying so hard. Visible heroic struggle — and visible failure. The bars are too strong.

pages.english_text: Suddenly — a great shadow fell on him!
pages.scene_description: EMOTIONAL PEAK 2. The angle pulls back — a huge dark shadow has fallen across Link and the bars. Link freezes, hands still on the bars, head turning to look up over his shoulder, his face just beginning to register horror. Above him, framed in a great open arch at the top of the staircase, is the silhouette of the HELMAROC KING — enormous, white-feathered, the red-and-gold iron mask catching torchlight, talons spread, wings filling the entire archway. Aryll inside the cell SHRIEKS, hands over her mouth.

pages.english_text: The Great Bird grabbed Link in its talons!
pages.scene_description: The Helmaroc King has lunged forward and snatched Link up in one massive talon. Link is held struggling, both arms pinned at his sides, his small sword falling away from his hand to clatter on the stone. His face is twisted in pain and fury, mouth open in a yell. The bird's masked head is huge in the frame, one cold eye visible through the iron mask. Behind, Aryll screams from the cell, reaching one tiny arm through the bars after her brother.

pages.english_text: The bird flew up. It carried Link far over the sea.
pages.scene_description: Wide shot. The Helmaroc King has burst out through the top of the fortress and is climbing into the storming night sky, Link tiny and limp in one talon. The fortress falls away below, becoming small. The vast dark ocean stretches in every direction, the moon racing behind ragged clouds. Wind whips. Link is a little dot of green against an enormous wild sky. Helpless scale.

pages.english_text: Then the bird threw him down. Link fell into the sea.
pages.scene_description: EMOTIONAL PEAK 3. The Helmaroc King has opened its talon. Link is falling — mid-air, arms and legs splayed, cap lost, hair streaming, mouth open in a silent scream. Below him, the dark churning ocean rises up. The bird wheels away above with empty talons. Above, a single distant moon. Link is utterly alone in the air, falling. The cruel scale of the sky.

pages.english_text: Down he sank in the cold dark water.
pages.scene_description: EMOTIONAL PEAK 4. Underwater shot. Link is sinking gently, eyes closed, body limp, arms drifting slightly, green tunic billowing softly. Bubbles trail upward from him. Above, far above, the surface of the water is a rippling pale glow with one tiny moon. Cold green-blue light surrounds him. Quiet, eerie, devastating. He is small and lost in the dim deep. NOT DROWNED — just sinking, unconscious. Silence.

pages.english_text: He woke up on a quiet beach. The dawn was pink.
pages.scene_description: Soft pale dawn. Link lies on his side on the wet sand of a small beach, eyes just opening, a tiny trickle of seawater at his cheek, hair plastered down. Around him: gentle pink-gold sunrise light, the calm sea lapping behind him, white sand, distant colorful Windfall houses on a hillside in the background. And beside him on the sand, pulled up out of the water: a small red wooden sailboat with a carved red lion figurehead. He has not yet seen the boat. The color palette has completely changed: warm, soft, hopeful in tone but the boy looks broken.

pages.english_text: The little boat spoke! "I am the King of Red Lions."
pages.scene_description: EMOTIONAL PEAK 5 — the wonder beat. Link has sat up partway on the sand, propping himself on one arm, his face frozen in pure astonishment — mouth slightly open, eyes huge and round. Across from him, the carved red-lion figurehead on the prow of the small red boat has turned its wooden head slightly toward him and OPENED ITS WOODEN MOUTH — it is speaking. The figurehead's eyes are gentle and ancient. Soft golden dawn light catches the carved wood. The strangest, most wondrous moment in the book. He is hearing a boat talk.

pages.english_text: "My sister is in the fortress! I must go back!"
pages.scene_description: Link has scrambled up onto his knees on the sand and reaches one hand out toward the boat, the other arm gesturing back toward the open sea — in the direction the fortress lies. His small face is desperate, pleading, exhausted. He is begging the talking boat to take him back to save Aryll. The wooden lion figurehead on the boat watches him calmly, gently, sadly.

pages.english_text: The King looked at him. "Not yet."
pages.scene_description: FIRST 'NŌNDUM' BEAT. Calm, weighted close-up of the carved red-lion figurehead. Its wooden mouth is shaped around the single word. Its eyes look gently at Link. The viewer feels both the kindness and the finality of the word. In the lower edge of the frame, a sliver of Link's face: stricken, eyes wide and beginning to glisten. The light is soft pink-gold. Quiet authority.

pages.english_text: Link sat down. He hung his head. He had failed.
pages.scene_description: EMOTIONAL LOW POINT (the failure). Link sits cross-legged on the wet sand with shoulders slumped forward, head bowed, hands limp in his lap. His green cap is gone, his blonde hair is messy and damp, his face is hidden by his hair. A single tear visible on his cheek. The little red boat sits patiently a few feet away on the sand, watching him. The dawn light is soft and gentle around them. He is a small green shape on a vast pale beach. Crushed, but not abandoned.

pages.english_text: The boat sailed slowly out to sea. "Not yet. But we will try again."
pages.scene_description: EMOTIONAL PEAK 6 — the renewed resolve. The little red boat is now afloat in the calm dawn sea, its single white sail raised and full of soft morning wind. Link sits in the boat at the stern, knees drawn up but head finally lifted, looking out forward over the bow toward the open horizon — not back at the fortress. His face is not happy, but it is steady. The carved red-lion figurehead at the prow leads the way, its mouth shaped around the words. A wide, hopeful sky of pink and gold. They are tiny on a huge calm ocean, sailing away into the rising sun. The story does not end — it begins again.
